text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS. Biwa Hayahide 
felt an uncharacteristic nervousness on 
the grand GⅠ stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Using this major race as fuel for 
constructing her theories, Biwa Hayahide 
reaffirmed her vow deep down in her heart.
